svg.title: 68 courses, stacked year by year
svg.desc: Every course from a Bachelor's in Mechatronics Engineering and a Master's in Electrical and Computer Engineering, drawn as periodic-table tiles stacked by year and coloured by layer, from people and math at the base up to digital hardware, robotics and software.

text.font-family: ui-monospace,'SFMono-Regular','JetBrains Mono','Cascadia Mono',Menlo,Consolas,'DejaVu Sans Mono','Liberation Mono',monospace
-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','Inter',system-ui,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif
